description: In front of you on the bed are a yellow bowl with a small item inside, a blue plate with a red handle, a white measuring scoop, and a red token marked “12.” The right hand moves in from the right toward the yellow bowl, reaches in to grasp the small item as a right-hand object, lifts it out, carries it rightward, and sets it down onto the blue plate before letting go, while the left hand stays near the lower left without touching anything.
